root: Persistent non-interactive Agent installations now schedule exact-version updates in a detached worker with durable progress, bounded retry, and explicit opt-out controls.
Search, describe, one-shot execution, fast paths, and MCP now share one intent plan with personalization, feasibility, named ranking evidence, and typo-aware site resolution.
GitHub discovery now covers repositories, issues, pull requests, code, commits, topics, users, and file reads through structured gh commands.
The documentation site now publishes an indexed cross-version history, exact comparison links, and machine-readable release data from the canonical changelog.
zh: 持久化安装由非交互 Agent 使用时，Uni-CLI 会通过后台 worker 安装准确版本，并提供持久化进度、限定重试和明确的关闭选项。
Search、describe、one-shot、fast path 和 MCP 现在共用一份 intent plan，其中包含个性化、可行性、命名排序依据和容错站点解析。
GitHub discovery 现在通过结构化 gh 命令覆盖仓库、Issue、Pull Request、代码、Commit、Topic、用户和文件读取。
文档站现在从统一 CHANGELOG 生成跨版本索引、准确比较链接和机器可读版本记录。
